_about.note: Evidence category of every ProgressionBalance field (Prompt 08, part G: upgrades, knowledge, learning, exercise). Categories: balance (game tuning, no source; never a NASA figure), S02 (length of a sol), S08 (ISS ECLSS mechanism), fiction scaled from S09 (MOXIE mechanism; colony-size unit is fiction). Source ids refer to docs/source_register.md.

card_parts.note: Parts each card consumes (2 to 4). The cheapest card of each sector costs 2, so the 10 starting parts buy one card per sector.

battery_capacity_factor.note: energy_battery_reserve: battery capacity x 1.25 once (800 -> 1000 kWh). Fiction 2080 battery bank.

battery_life_support_reserve_fraction.note: energy_battery_reserve: the last 20 % of the capacity is kept for life support; room and greenhouse lights cannot draw it.

tracking_drive_factor.note: energy_solar_tracking: tracker drives use 0.5 x their power (0.6 -> 0.3 kW).

tracking_output_factor.note: energy_solar_tracking: tracking panels give 1.1 x (more exact aiming). Mechanism is physics (light straight on); the size is tuning.

cleaner_self_repair_sols.note: energy_cleaner_automation: a broken cleaner repairs itself after 1 sol (24.66 game hours, S02). The one-sol choice is balance.

recycler_bonus_l_per_hour.note: ls_water_reliability: recycler +1 L/h (3 -> 4). The 90 % recovery stays the S08 value.

recycler_condition_floor.note: ls_water_reliability: recycler condition never below 0.8, so its water quality stays 100 %.

electrolysis_output_factor.note: ls_electrolysis: top output x 1.5 (0.2 -> 0.3 kg/h) at the same kWh per kg. S08 supports the mechanism (ISS electrolysis); the factor is balance. Water per kg stays the physics value 1.126.

co2_unit_output_factor.note: ls_co2_processing: top output x 1.5 (0.15 -> 0.225 kg/h). MOXIE (S09) supports the mechanism; a colony-size unit and its upgrade are fiction.

monitoring_reserve_warn_factor.note: ls_oxygen_monitoring: oxygen reserve warning at 1.5 x the normal level (20 -> 30 kg).

monitoring_o2_warn_margin_kpa.note: ls_oxygen_monitoring: cabin oxygen warning 1 kPa earlier (19 -> 20 kPa).

monitoring_co2_warn_margin_kpa.note: ls_oxygen_monitoring: cabin CO2 warning 0.1 kPa earlier (0.5 -> 0.4 kPa).

low_output_share.note: Contract value: a fix counts as a diagnosis when the panels gave less than 80 % of their clean output.

recovered_output_share.note: Contract value: recovery means more than 95 % of the clean output.

recovery_window_sols.note: Contract value: the recovery must be seen within 1 sol of the fix.

process_run_hours.note: Contract value: each oxygen process must run at least 1 game hour for ls_distinguish_inputs.

exercise_stamina_cost.note: Body energy (stamina 0..100) one exercise session uses. Not electricity: the battery is never touched.

conditioning_recovery_per_hour.note: Extra body energy recovered per game hour at full conditioning; 0 when untrained, so the existing stamina feel is unchanged.
